scope: independent raw-sample recomputation; TCPv2 corpus only

metric_definitions.goodput: receiver-verified delivered application bytes / receiver monotonic duration, decimal MB/s and Mbit/s; median of seven round observations; direction-specific
metric_definitions.RTT: established-session application 64-byte request/response RTT; median of each round's 256 integer nanosecond observations then median across seven round medians; not setup
metric_definitions.setup: fresh-connection first verified response; median of each round's eight samples then median across seven round medians; separately reported
metric_definitions.dispersion: min/max/Q1/Q3/IQR/MAD calculated over seven per-round medians/observations
metric_definitions.paired: per-round candidate-to-official ratios, same case/round, separately for directions and RTT
metric_definitions.established_RTT_us_all_1792_samples: SUPPLEMENTAL only: pooled marginal distribution of all 256×7 integer established-echo samples; not the predeclared primary estimator.
metric_definitions.fresh_setup_first_response_ms_all_56_sam: SUPPLEMENTAL only: pooled marginal distribution of all 8×7 setup-first-response observations; not the predeclared primary estimator.
metric_definitions.established_RTT_us: PRIMARY latency estimator: median of seven per-round medians (each round median over that cell’s 256 established-echo observations); variation fields cover the seven round medians. The pooled all-1792-observation marginal median/distribution is supplemental only.
metric_definitions.fresh_setup_first_response_ms: PRIMARY setup estimator: median of seven per-round medians (each round median over that cell’s eight fresh-response observations); setup is separate from established RTT. The pooled all-56-observation marginal median/distribution is supplemental only.

host_preservation_note: TCP closure reports host service preservation false; preservation record notes a running service disappeared between passive captures without an observed cause. No claim all services unchanged.
